game_concept: A action puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Summit Spire, the highest spire: the mountaineer must handle storm winds while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Checkpoint: Check key membership with in before reading dictionary values.
theme: Frost Peaks – Summit Spire: the highest spire
core_gameplay_loop: In Summit Spire, repeat each round: Check key membership with in before reading dictionary values. Each round, a new ropes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the checkpoint value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 420 points of ropes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 420, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Key Checkpoint
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Checkpoint' (Week 8 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Summit Spire'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how checkpoint changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm winds in Summit Spire.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 420 within 54 seconds.
